cohort: 203 women aged 20-50 years without complaints of pelvic floor dysfunction
finding: 3D ultrasound can identify mild morphological changes in young women with apparently normal physical examinations, mainly after vaginal or forceps delivery, which are associated with higher incidences of underreported sexual, urinary, and anal symptoms.
mod_finding: Women who had vaginal or forceps deliveries were more likely to present with urinary incontinence, flatus incontinence, and sexual dysfunction compared to nulliparous women and those who underwent caesarean section.
